crossRefs.note: Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all, and have followed you.”
Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything, and followed you. What then will we have?”
When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.
So therefore whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.
Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”
Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord…

parallels.note: They immediately left their nets and followed him.
They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

translations.web: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.
translations.bsb: And at once they left their nets and followed Him.
translations.kjv: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
translations.asv: And straightway they left the nets, and followed him.
